Name: More Buildings Expanded
Author: Amichwan
Description:
[b]New Buildable Structures: Two types of Greenhouses and Cellars[/b]

This mod adds [b]nine fully separate buildable structures[/b], divided into three upgrade levels for each type. You can [b]construct multiple buildings of each type[/b] independently.

[b][u]Cellar[/u][/b]
Age wines outside your farmhouse.
[b]Requirement:[/b] Cannot be built until your farmhouse cellar is upgraded. Once unlocked, build and upgrade with Robin.

Little Cellar 🡺 Big Cellar 🡺 Deluxe Cellar

[b][u]Greenhouse[/u][/b]
Smaller greenhouses for growing crops, taking less space than the main greenhouse.
[b]Requirement:[/b] Cannot be built until you unlock the main greenhouse.

Little Greenhouse 🡺 Big Greenhouse 🡺 Deluxe Greenhouse

[b][u]Tree Greenhouse[/u][/b]
Designed for trees, taking less map space than the main greenhouse.
[b]Requirement:[/b] Cannot be built until you unlock the main greenhouse.

Tree Greenhouse 🡺 Big Tree Greenhouse 🡺 Deluxe Tree Greenhouse

[b][u]Paintable:[/u][/b]
Buildings can be painted at their [b]highest upgrade[/b].

[b][u]Multilingual Support:[/u][/b]
All text is [b]AI-translated[/b]. Feedback on translations is welcome.

[b][u]Update 1.0.5[/u][/b]

Added [b]Clean map versions[/b] for [b]Cellar, Greenhouse, and Tree Greenhouse[/b] across [b]all upgrade levels[/b].
Clean maps remove [b]unnecessary decorations[/b], providing a [b]simpler and more open layout[/b].
Cellar clean maps also [b]fix wall and floor visuals[/b] for a cleaner and more consistent interior.

[b][u]Update 1.0.4[/u][/b]

[b]Configuration:[/b] The mod now includes full customization for:
• [b]Construction cost[/b]
• [b]Required materials[/b]
• [b]Build days[/b]

[b]Important:[/b] When configuring prices and/or materials, you must enter a numeric value. If not, the building will "break".

[b]Difficulty Mode:[/b] A new [b]Easy/Normal[/b] difficulty option has been added.
• [b]Easy:[/b] Buildings can be constructed immediately without requirements.
• [b]Normal:[/b] Requirements remain as in vanilla progression.

[b][u]Compatibility:[/u][/b]
May conflict with mods that add similar cellars or greenhouses.
Supports [b]GMCM[/b] — enable or disable buildings and upgrades via the config menu.
